Sasha: Quick midday poll — office lunch bracket time. Pick one for Wednesday and we'll order for anyone in-office: 

1) Deli Delight (warm roast beef special) :bread:
2) Veggie Hub (build-your-own bowls) :leafy_green: 
3) Nori Rolls (handrolls + miso) :sushi: 

React with :one:, :two:, or :three:. I'll tally at 11:30 and place the order. :smiley:

Priya: Love this. voting :two:

Liam: :one: unless there's a vegan option for Noa — do they have one?

Noah: I can do anything, but prefer :three: 

Marco: :one: for the roast beef. Also +1 if anyone wants chips on the side. :potato:

Jules: :two: — huge fan of the spicy sesame dressing.

Sasha: @Noah there are vegan bowls at Veggie Hub, they let you swap protein for tofu/tempeh.

Priya: also, can we do the usual dietary notes in the order? (GF: Liam, Vegan: Noah)

lunch-bot: poll update — 3 votes for :one:, 2 votes for :two:, 1 vote for :three:. (cuts off at 11:30)

Liam: ok cool, :one: works then, thanks.

Marco: chips? anyone?

Priya: yes please chips. and one side salad if that's cheap.

Sasha: final tally at 11:31 -> Deli Delight wins 4-2-1. Ordering roast beef platters, chips on the side, 1 GF salad, 1 vegan bowl for Noah. ETA ~12:05.

Noah: heck yeah, appreciate it :heart:

Jules: you rock, Sasha. :sparkles:

lunch-bot: order placed (order# 4227). Delivery ETA 12:04.
